title: parameria angustior
intro: Parameria angustior, commonly known as  Indian Snakeroot or Sarpagandha, is a plant species native to the Indian subcontinent.  It is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including anxiety, insomnia, and hypertension, due to its health benefits of reducing stress and promoting relaxation. The plant exhibits therapeutic actions such as sedative, antispasmodic, and antihypertensive properties. Parameria angustior contains bioactive constituents like alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
